name: crosstalk
description: Crosstalk — a self-hosting coordination bus for AI coding-agent sessions: cross-machine messaging, presence, a shared work board with a distributed claim-lock, zero-config leader discovery + failover, and a human console. One clone on any node can host the bus or connect to whoever is hosting.
